slides.headline:
Your charger says 100 W.
You are getting 60.
slides.subhead: macOS says “Charging” while the battery goes down. Smart Charging shows the real number.

slides.headline:
It names the cause,
not just the number.
slides.subhead: A weak cable lowers the current. A weak port lowers the voltage. Both feel like “slow charging” and need opposite fixes.

slides.headline:
And tells you
when it is right.
slides.subhead: 140 W on the 28 V rail — PD 3.1 end to end, with the wall carrying the whole load.

slides.headline:
Built for people
running local models.
slides.subhead: Ollama and oMLX push an Apple silicon chip near its sustained limit. That is when an undersized charger stops hiding.
